messages:
Lina: Scan alert — nightly link-check found 3 broken assets in /docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md (KV cache tuning). Gist gone + 2 s3 images. Can someone grab?
DocsBot: report: 3 broken assets, 1 orphan anchor. Full: https://internal.docs/reports/2820012345-scan
Omar: I can take the images. Will rehost to https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/ and update alt text.
Priya: I'll inline the gist (small snippet) and add a changelog line.
Dan: Quick note — the orphan anchor is from a header rename. Recommend re-adding a small HTML anchor to preserve old links.
Lina: OK plan: @omar rehost images, @priya inline gist & add changelog, @dan confirm anchor fix. Label PR `docs, quick-fix`.
Priya: Local commands I used:
```bash
rg "gist.github.com/kv-example|s3://redwood-assets/kv" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md -n
sed -i "s|s3://redwood-assets/|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/|g" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md
```
Omar: Images uploaded to CDN and replaced in branch.
Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/14007 — includes scan link, changelog, and i18n: no note. Requesting @lina and @omar for review.
Dan: Reviewing now, left one nit on alt text. Also added a paragraph comment explaining the HTML anchor restore for backwards compatibility.
Lina: Thanks — once CI passes please trigger the rescan job.
DocsBot: queued re-scan on merge.
Lina: Resolving when CI + re-scan green. :white_check_mark:
